group.intro.entry.variants-exact.content: Exact match: xy_shy. Next, switch the first dimension to exercise a missing combination.
group.intro.entry.variants-reduced.conte: Requested solo_shy; removing the second dimension shows solo (a copy of wink). Save and load here: the shy selection is retained.
group.intro.entry.variants-remembered.co: Switching the first dimension back to xy restores the remembered xy_shy.
group.intro.entry.variants-default.conte: The background request classroom_speech_empty has no match, so the explicit default classroom_idle_empty is shown. Save and load here too.
group.intro.entry.variants-scene.content: Selecting teacher in the third dimension matches classroom_speech_teacher, retaining the earlier speech request.
group.intro.entry.variants-reset.content: Hide and re-show resets the portrait to xy_idle. A later selection switches to wink during the loop animation.
group.intro.entry.intro-line-1.content: Start with image variants: exact matches, fallback, remembered selections and resetting on show.
group.intro.entry.intro-video-background: niko.mp4 is a scene layer below the portrait, with rotation, scale and opacity. This non-blocking video lets dialogue advance. Advance to stop it.
group.intro.entry.intro-line-effect-on.c: A seffect.gain effect is now active, ducking this BGM track while the scene continues.
The track effect has been removed and the BGM volume is restored.
group.intro.entry.intro-line-low-pass.co: A low-pass SEffect now removes the BGM's higher bands. Advance to remove it.
group.intro.entry.intro-line-high-pass.c: A high-pass SEffect now removes the BGM's lower bands. Advance to restore the full track.
group.intro.entry.intro-line-2.content: The portrait is rapidly bobbing through a non-blocking additive loop.
group.intro.entry.intro-line-3.content: The blocking rotation has completed before this line is shown.
group.intro.entry.intro-line-4.content: Now the non-blocking portrait loop is stopped explicitly.

group.intro.entry.nvl-append-history.con: This is the second paragraph in the scrollable NVL history.

group.intro.entry.intro-line-5.content: Basic audio complete. Continue this chapter to compare the additional sound effects.
Save here and load the new save: the scene and gain effect return, and BGM stays paused. Advance to resume it from the beginning.
